hints.text: Stack the numbers so the decimal points are right on top of each other.
Tenths first: $4 + 7 = 11$ tenths, which is $1$ whole and $1$ tenth — so you carry.
$3 + 2 = 5$, plus the carried $1$ is $6$, and $1$ tenth is left: $6.1$.

explanation: Line up the decimal points so that tenths are under tenths and ones are under ones.
Add the tenths: $4 + 7 = 11$ tenths. That is $1$ whole and $1$ tenth, so write $1$ tenth and carry the whole.
Add the ones together with the carried whole: $3 + 2 + 1 = 6$ ones.
Six ones and one tenth make $6.1$, so $3.4 + 2.7 = 6.1$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Estimate to check
steps: Round both numbers to $3$, so the sum should be close to $3 + 3 = 6$.
Now fix the rounding: $3.4$ is $0.4$ above $3$, and $2.7$ is $0.3$ below $3$.
Adjust the estimate by both amounts: $6 + 0.4 - 0.3 = 6.1$.
